purpose: Preserve scorer CLI failures and successful pre-final postprocessing for audit; these directories are not final analysis outputs.

attempts.action: Load the pinned lower sensitivity wrapper for reference directories and its six-hour scorer; bind the wrapper hash.

attempts.failure: ValueError writing gate_equal_mass_comparison.csv: heterogeneous categorical/continuous row keys.
attempts.action: Use deterministic union CSV headers and explicit row_type/metric/unit; blank fields remain blank.

attempts.failure: CLI final display failed: TypeError: tuple indices must be integers or slices, not str. A trailing comma formed a one-element tuple around the receipt dict.
attempts.artifact_receipt_shape: one-element JSON array, therefore archived as a failed postprocess attempt.
attempts.action: Remove trailing comma; add full no-winner postprocessing fixture; rerun and verify plain-object receipt.

attempts.failure: Independent recount ValueError: hour 13 array archive keys differ from receipt. NPZ persisted all 39 prior contexts plus 8 new cases; contract requires only the frozen 12 contexts plus reference/coordinates.
attempts.action: Filter prior context arrays to the frozen context set when constructing the canonical archive, then rescore/recount/replay.

attempts.failure: Earlier replay compared receipts created with relative runtime/plan argument spellings against the canonical receipt created with absolute default paths. identity() preserves the supplied path string. A same-seed absolute-path replay showed raw receipt equality; no nondeterminism was found.
attempts.action: Normalize analysis/runtime/plan arguments with Path.resolve() in replay and rerun with the canonical absolute paths under two distinct PYTHONHASHSEED values.

attempts.cause: Canonical scoring used default absolute runtime and plan paths; earlier replay invocations supplied relative paths. identity() binds the supplied path spelling, so receipt.json alone differed even though parsed analysis fields and all data outputs matched.
attempts.fix: replay() resolves analysis, runtime, and plan paths before invoking the scorer; a regression test confirms relative arguments are normalized. Final seed 0 and seed 1 replays passed all 29 outputs byte-for-byte with absolute canonical arguments.
attempts.evidence: review/independent_recount_replay_seed0.json and seed1.json both report 29 byte-identical outputs and the same canonical receipt SHA.

attempts.failure: Copied-checkout test rejected a path equality between the frozen absolute selection-plan runtime_directory and checkout-derived RUNTIME_DIR.
attempts.action: Remove only the redundant location comparison from selection-plan validation; exact selection plan hash remains pinned, and runtime common-plan/source/history validation remains required. Then rescore once and strict replay.

attempts.comparison: All 28 data output artifacts byte-identical to the prior accepted run; receipt source binding updated.

cleanup: Attempts 1 and 2 used score() exception cleanup and removed their output directories. Attempt 3 files are preserved in this directory.
